claims.claim_ar: النص يتخذ أسلوبًا تهديديًا لمخاطبة المشركين وتوبيخهم على ادعائهم للفاحشة.
claims.claim_en: The verse employs a threatening/admonishing rhetorical tone toward the polytheists, rebuking them for their claim.

claims.source_quote_ar: وجدنا عليها آباءنا والله أمرنا بها
claims.claim_ar: مقابلة بلاغية بين ادعاء المشركين ("وجدنا عليها آباءنا والله أمرنا بها") وبين تكذيب/إنكار ما يَزعمون عن الله (أن يقولوا على الله ما لا يعلمون)، فتُبرز النقيض لفضح تناقضهم.
claims.claim_en: A rhetorical contrast (muqabalah) is set up between the people's claim "we found it on our fathers, and God ordered it" and the Quranic rebuke that they are saying about God what they do not know — the opposition exposes their hypocrisy.
claims.needs_review_reason: Inference of a formal muqabalah relies on reading together the quoted claim and the general reproach (other verse phrasing appears in the tafsir); verify with original balagha sources for an explicit label of this device.

warnings: Source chunks provided are primarily tafsir excerpts (Tabari, Kashshaf). Classical balagha authors named in the task (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti) are not present among the provided chunks; claims are therefore based on the available tafsir material.
